outcome: A level bar's ability is activatable only at sorcery speed when the Class is at level N-1, and once the Class is level N or greater it has the level's abilities.
A permanent keeps its level even if it stops being a Class, and a copy does not copy the level.
A permanent without a level is treated as level 1 by rules and effects that refer to its level.
A Class's abilities not preceded by a level bar apply from the moment it is on the battlefield, whatever its level.
Level counters on a leveler do not affect a Class's level, and class levels do not affect leveler cards.
